preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.
The list of vertex prices c has exactly n elements.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= ci <= 10**9 for ci in c)
preconditions.description: Each vertex price ci is between 0 and 10^9 inclusive.
The number of edges is exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n for a, b in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two vertices between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.description: The minimum cost s is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(k, int) and k >= 1 and k <= n
postconditions.description: The number of vertices k in at least one optimal set is between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(vertices, list) and len(vertices) == k and all(1 <= v <= n for v in vertices) and len(set(vertices)) == k
postconditions.description: The list of vertices contains k distinct integers between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(v in vertices for v in optimal_vertices)
postconditions.description: All vertices in any optimal set are included in the output list of vertices.
